outcome.technical: P131-R30 fixed: _impact._file_dependants now builds the private-name referrers only from non-prose files (is_doc), so a document that names the module no longer counts as a user of its private names. The module docstring and _name_users docstring were updated to match. Cases: im3c is new; im3b's fixture now has a CI step naming the module's path and a private name, which still counts, while docs/guide.md naming _round_down does not. P131-R39 fixed: run-test-gate.py no longer defines tree_key. It binds `tree_key = _ev.tree_key` for its readers (test_run_test_gate, test_drive_phase sv7) and writes testedState.tree.key through _ev.tree_key. The unused hashlib import was dropped, and _evidence_io.tree_key's docstring now calls it the only spelling. New case tk1 asserts rtg.tree_key is _evidence_io.tree_key. sv7 in tests/test_drive_phase.py now compares one function with itself; it is outside my files, so I left it for its owner to delete or keep. P135-R1, partly fixed and partly reported: (a) the config half was already done at HEAD. _manifest_io.PLUGIN_OWNED_WHILE_UNTRACKED holds CONFIG_NAME, and _scoped_commit.plugin_owned_rels skips it while git tracks it (sc-ua9 and ctw-at10 pin this). (b) The 'at minimum' half was also already at HEAD: commit_work does `skipped = skipped + notes` before returning the refusal, and render prints the degraded lines before REFUSED. New case ctw-at19 now pins that the refusal output carries the plugin-owned line naming .claude/.gitignore and .claude/audit.config.json. (c) Not done: waving a TRACKED .gitignore only when every added line is one the plugin writes. That check needs the panel's ignore patterns (_PANEL_PRIVATE_FILES in plugins/audit/scripts/panel/panel-server.py, not my file) moved into one table in _manifest_io for both writers and the check to read. sc-ua9 also currently pins a tracked, edited .gitignore as plugin-owned whatever its content, so this design change goes back to the orchestrator. P135-R2 fixed: ctw-at9 now asserts os.path.join(root, '.claude', _mio.CONFIG_NAME) is a table row. The _manifest_io comment now says ctw-at9 pins the rows by name. Measured: deleting the row also reddens ctw-at7 at HEAD, so the finding's claim that no case went red no longer holds, but the row now has a case that names it. P137-R26 fixed in the structural scan (tests/test__scoped_commit.py), which is now transitive. A name assigned from any expression holding a by-key read or a followed name is followed, including through tuples, calls and `or`. A followed list handed to a call is named unless the callee is in PRESENTATION_CALLS or is a same-file helper, which is then scanned with that parameter followed. _only_membership now accepts only a lower-case name, or a by-key read of one, bound in the function from a non-literal. A loop over a followed list is named for a `continue`, or for a branch on any other condition that uses the loop variable. The comment now lists what the scan still cannot see: in-place methods, slices, other modules' helpers named rather than followed, getattr/exec. New case sc-ua18 runs eight hole mutations of the real commit-task-work source: call-wrapped, re-wrapped, narrowing helper, attribute comparator, call comparator, unbound module list, else-branch loop, tuple/or unpack. All went unseen at HEAD and all are named now. New case sc-ua19 is the allow twin: presentation builtin, presenting helper, bound set. sc-ua11's `allowed` mutation now binds mine_elsewhere in the function. sc-ua10 stays clean on both real readers (bound 1, no violations). P137-R29 fixed: tracking renamed _tracking, with its one caller in plugin_owned_rels and a docstring naming the case. New case sc-ua20 walks scripts/ for calls of _tracking or tracking, expects only (_scoped_commit.py, plugin_owned_rels), and is shown to see a planted caller. P142-R18 partly fixed: the RUNNER_LINE_END_PENDING comment now gives the reason in code terms (private readers reached only through failing_cases/read_tally, which normalise; final_error strips after matching) and names what deletes each row (the function calling plain_text itself, after which the lint reports the row as stale). Deleting the rows needs plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_runner_output.py and stamp-verification.py, which are outside my files; runner_line_end_violations(pending=()) still returns those three sites (_runner_output.py:444, :594, stamp-verification.py:730). The gate passed: exit 0, 6/6 files ok, 1361 cases. Dependant suites run via sweep, exit 0: test_audit_lookup 143, test__deps 254, test__refs 292, test_drive_phase 671 (sv7 included), test__manifest_io 189. ruff check plugins/audit tools tests passed with exit 0, and vermin -t=3.8- on the changed files passed with exit 0. Dependants: _impact.py's readers audit-lookup.py and test_audit_lookup.py are unaffected (green), and the PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md mention is unchanged; this change removes that guide from private-name users, which was the finding. _evidence_io.py's sixty-odd importers are unaffected: tree_key's signature and value are unchanged and only the docstring moved. run-test-gate.py keeps the module name tree_key, so test_run_test_gate (green) and test_drive_phase sv7 (green) still read it, and its doc and config dependants name the script, not tree_key. commit-task-work.py's code is unchanged. _manifest_io.py: comment only. _scoped_commit.py: the only rename is tracking to _tracking, which had no other caller in plugins, tests or tools (grep). tools/lints/_output_lints.py: comment only (test__output_lints green in the gate). The test files' dependants (.github/sweep-costs.json, tools/affected.py) name them by path, and no path changed.
